summary: Closure review: the revised manuscript documents a sealed, preregistered paired study with archived artifacts and internally consistent analysis showing a near‑null marginal verifier+single‑repair effect under shared_initial_candidate semantics (N=250 pairs). Three prior required editorial/disclosure items remain unresolved and must be fixed before finalisation.
critical_issues: Disclosure Statement still exposes low‑level execution bookkeeping (per-file paths and numerous full artifact hashes) rather than a concise manifest pointer; this duplicates archive metadata in the paper body and violates the track guidance.

Abstract does not explicitly state that the preregistered sim‑to‑real/production-like confirmatory contrast was not executed and that the reported confirmatory estimand applies only to the synthetic/emulation partition.

References are not presented as a conventional IEEE numbered bibliography with full bibliographic metadata and in‑text numeric citations verified to support proximate scholarly claims (identifier-only entries remain).
required_revisions: Condense the Disclosure Statement: remove per-file paths and per-artifact full hashes from the manuscript body and replace them with a single concise evidence-bundle manifest pointer (for example: the execution manifest path `execution/execution_manifest.json` and/or the published evidence-bundle manifest SHA‑256 = 7a984dbf7265c9a774eaf95c6c930dcf5f1e8845088bbc0e0855e3b4f1000ede). Keep the Disclosure Statement within the five‑page manuscript and do not duplicate Methods/Results content; leave per-file bookkeeping in the archived bundle referenced by the manifest pointer.

Add an explicit sentence to the Abstract that states the preregistered sim‑to‑real/production‑like confirmatory contrast was not executed and that the reported confirmatory estimand/inference applies only to the synthetic/emulation partition. Suggested concise wording: “The preregistered sim‑to‑real/production‑like confirmatory contrast was not executed; the reported confirmatory estimand therefore applies only to the synthetic/emulation partition used in this run.”

Convert the References section into a conventional IEEE numbered bibliography (authors, title, venue, year, DOI/URL where available). Replace any identifier-only reference entries with full bibliographic metadata (verified records are available in terminal_bibliographic_records) and ensure each in-text numeric citation maps to the correct reference and actually supports the proximate claim.
optional_revisions: Shorten Related Work to the closest adjacent papers (e.g., Verified Prompt Programming, Batfish evolution, NetConfEval) and explicitly contrast how the shared_initial_candidate paired design differs from prior GVR evaluations.

Add one concise paragraph (no raw artifact paths) mapping adapter/provider audit labels (e.g., condition_counts and stage_counts) to pipeline stages (initial generation, validator check, repair) to aid reader comprehension.

Add a one-line explicit callout in Limitations noting that the realized baseline pass rate (0.996) departed from the preregistered power assumption (~0.90), reducing power to detect small absolute improvements.
